# scylladbcloud_cluster_datacenters (Data Source)

The datacenters of a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_cluster_datacenters" "example" {
	cluster_id = 1337
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `datacenters` (List of Object) Datacenters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datacenters))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
